actual_stop.source_contract_observation: The controller marks any 504 as deadline_timeout observed, then samples after_metrics and switches the injected delay off. This first 504 took about 5 seconds and did not increase total timeout. Earlier two probes of the same type took about 8 seconds. The recorded production phase boundaries are header=5s and total=8s; a status alone does not distinguish them.
actual_stop.attribution: The original samples show passive ejection and retry exhaustion near the early 504, but cannot identify the exact eligibility/permit decision of this logical probe. No production total-deadline defect is inferred.

raw_error_review.reason_attribution: The 15 GOAWAY/ENHANCE_YOUR_CALM facts are actual Hyper source-chain observations. Their underlying library trigger is not captured; the other 93 have real null cause fields and are not assigned that reason.
